message.content:
The visible section is the **homepage hero area** of the Tostem website.  

### Content:  
- **Branding & Tagline**: The Tostem logo (“TOSTEM”) and tagline (“Japanese Innovation in Window Design”) appear at the top.  
- **Navigation Menu**: A dark gray menu bar with options like *ABOUT TOSTEM*, *WHY TOSTEM*, *OUR PRODUCTS*, *TOSTEM EXPERIENCE*, *KNOWLEDGE*, and *REACH US* (each with a dropdown arrow).  
- **Hero Image & Text**: A large image of a modern house with trees, overlaid with bold text (“Japanese Innovation … Window Design”) and a descriptive paragraph: *“Experience the perfect blend of Japanese precision engineering and elegant design with Tostem's premium aluminium windows and doors.”*  
- **Call-to-Action (CTA) Buttons**: Two vertical CTAs on the left/right: *“DOWNLOAD BROCHURE”* (left) and *“ENQUIRE NOW”* (right). A “2 Issues” notification with an “Explore Products” button is at the bottom left. A scroll-to-top button is at the bottom right.  


### Layout:  
- The header (logo, tagline, menu) is fixed at the top.  
- The hero section occupies most of the viewport, with the image as the background and text/CTAs layered on top.  
- CTAs are positioned vertically (left/right) for easy access, and the “Explore Products” button is at the bottom left.  


### Issues (if any):  
- No obvious functional issues are visible, but the “2 Issues” notification (likely a cookie/consent banner) may be intrusive for some users.  
- The layout is clean and focused on showcasing the brand’s value (Japanese innovation in window design) and driving user action (download brochure, enquire).  


This section effectively introduces Tostem’s brand identity, product focus, and encourages user engagement.
